capabilities.title: Home server app-store UX: one-click install, uninstall, and update for self-hosted apps
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Umbrel app store: catalog of self-hosted apps with single-click management
capabilities.reason: Nexus COMMAND could adapt app-store UX patterns for managing optional Nexus modules or integrations; design reference pending.

capabilities.title: Self-host onboarding UX: guided setup wizard for first-time home server configuration
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Umbrel onboarding: step-by-step setup with network, storage, and app config
capabilities.reason: Nexus desktop app has basic setup; a guided onboarding wizard with progress indicators is not yet implemented.

capabilities.title: App health dashboard: per-service status, resource usage, and restart controls
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Umbrel dashboard: CPU, RAM, storage per running service
capabilities.reason: Nexus COMMAND has status panels; a per-service resource usage and health control panel modeled on Umbrel's dashboard is pending.

capabilities.title: OpenClaw container runtime dependency for app management
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Umbrel uses container runtime for app isolation
capabilities.reason: User explicitly excluded OpenClaw runtime dependencies. Umbrel is reference-only for self-host UX patterns; its container runtime is not adopted.

capabilities.title: Bundled catalog of third-party self-hosted applications (Bitwarden, Nextcloud, etc.)
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a standalone intelligence dashboard, not an app marketplace. Bundling a third-party app catalog is out of scope.
